title: Multinational Networks and Trade Participation
title_zh: 跨国网络与贸易参与
title_primary: 跨国网络与贸易参与
title_secondary: Multinational Networks and Trade Participation
authors: Paola Conconi, Fabrizio Leone, Glenn Magerman, Catherine Thomas, Kalina Manova 等
official: 官方在线 2025-03-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we estimate event studies in a three-dimensional panel with staggered treatment effects, exploiting variation within multinational affiliates in their ownership status and across affiliates in the geographical structure of their parental network. We show that firms acquired by an MNC are more likely to start exporting to and importing from countries that belong—or that are exogenously added—to their parental network. We provide evidence suggesting that the effects increase with knowledge flows within the MNC hierarchy and extend beyond the boundaries of the multinational. In a model of firms’ export and import choices, firm-country-year-level gravity regressions isolate “MNC network effects” from other channels through which multinational ownership can affect firms’ trade participation. Combining the structure of the model with our empirical estimates, we find that MNC network effects have a large impact on new affiliates’ sales and employment growth.
abstract_zh: 我们在一个具有交错处理效应的三维面板中估计事件研究，利用跨国企业附属机构在所有权状态上的差异以及附属机构间在其母公司网络地理结构上的差异。我们表明，被跨国公司收购的企业更有可能开始向属于其母公司网络的国家出口和从这些国家进口——或这些国家被外生地加入该网络。我们提供的证据表明，这些效应随着跨国公司层级内的知识流动而增强，并延伸至跨国公司的边界之外。在企业进出口选择模型中，企业-国家-年份层面的引力回归将“跨国公司网络效应”与跨国所有权可能影响企业贸易参与的其他渠道区分开来。结合模型结构与我们的实证估计，我们发现跨国公司网络效应对新附属机构的销售和就业增长具有显著影响。

title: When Sectoral Recovery Fails to Aggregate
title_zh: 当部门复苏未能形成总体效应
title_primary: 当部门复苏未能形成总体效应
title_secondary: When Sectoral Recovery Fails to Aggregate
authors: Marc Klemp
official: 官方在线 2026-02-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does monotone sectoral recovery survive aggregation? With fixed nonnegative weights, it does. This paper studies the same preservation question when aggregation weights are endogenous Domar weights generated by a production network with gradual pass-through of intermediate-input cost changes. The aggregate derivative decomposes into a recovery push and a network drag, and the resulting reversal index gives an exact condition: aggregate displacement deepens if and only if the drag exceeds the push. This characterisation yields a sharp preservation boundary. Among nonnegative input-output matrices with spectral radius below one, the only matrix that preserves recovery for every admissible sectoral path is the no-network matrix $\Omega=0$. The drag passes through the network one more time than direct sectoral recovery, so it scales at a higher order in network connectivity. Two channels contribute in levels: growth of total Leontief-weighted cost exposure as pass-through rises, and reweighting toward sectors further behind in recovery. In an illustration using the 55-sector US input-output matrix and cross-sector robot density data, the drag peaks at nearly eight times the direct recovery effect under benchmark assumptions.
abstract_zh: 单调部门复苏能否在加总后得以保持？在固定非负权重下，答案是肯定的。本文研究当加总权重为内生Domar权重时，这一保持问题是否依然成立，其中Domar权重由具有中间投入成本变化渐进传导特征的生产网络生成。总导数分解为复苏推动力与网络拖拽力，由此得到的逆转指数给出了一个精确条件：当且仅当拖拽力超过推动力时，总体偏离程度加深。这一刻画得出了一个清晰的保持边界。在谱半径小于1的非负投入产出矩阵中，唯一能在所有可行部门路径下保持复苏性质的矩阵是无网络矩阵$\Omega=0$。拖拽力在网络中传导的次数比直接部门复苏多一次，因此其在网络连通性上具有更高阶的规模效应。两个渠道在水平上有所贡献：随着传导率上升，总Leontief加权成本暴露的增长；以及权重向复苏滞后部门的再分配。在利用美国55部门投入产出矩阵及跨部门机器人密度数据的示例中，基准假设下拖拽力峰值接近直接复苏效应的八倍。

title: High Order Openness
title_zh: 高阶开放性
title_primary: 高阶开放性
title_secondary: High Order Openness
authors: Jean M. Imbs, Laurent L. Pauwels
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2020-04-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a new measure of high order trade, labeled HOT, based on the fraction of a sector’s downstream uses that cross a border. Because it decomposes gross output, HOT evaluates a sector’s exposure to foreign shocks abstracting altogether from observed direct trade, which we exploit to construct instruments for openness. For the same reason, we can evaluate HOT with precision for activities where measured direct trade is essentially zero, like some services. We compute HOT and its instruments for 50 sectors in 43 countries using recently released data on international input-output linkages. We compare its properties with conventional measures that all rely on observed direct trade. HOT correlates positively with conventional trade measures across countries, much less across sectors as many more are open according to our measure. HOT correlates significantly with sector productivity, growth, and synchronization; none of the conventional measures do. Once instrumented, we show high order openness causes productivity and synchronization, but not growth.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的高阶贸易度量方法，称为HOT，基于一个部门下游用途中跨境流动的比例。由于HOT分解了总产出，它评估部门对外部冲击的暴露程度时完全撇开了观察到的直接贸易，我们利用这一特性构建开放度的工具变量。同样地，对于测量到的直接贸易几乎为零的活动（如某些服务业），我们也能精确评估HOT。我们利用最新发布的国际投入产出关联数据，计算了43个国家50个部门的HOT及其工具变量。我们将其属性与所有依赖观察到的直接贸易的传统度量方法进行比较。HOT在国家间与传统贸易度量呈正相关，但在部门间相关性较弱，因为根据我们的度量，更多部门是开放的。HOT与部门生产率、增长和同步性显著相关；而传统度量方法均无此相关性。一旦进行工具变量处理，我们表明高阶开放度会导致生产率和同步性提升，但不影响增长。

title: Demographic transition and the rise of wealth inequality
title_zh: 人口转型与财富不平等加剧
title_primary: 人口转型与财富不平等加剧
title_secondary: Demographic transition and the rise of wealth inequality
authors: Krzysztof Makarski, Joanna Tyrowicz, Piotr Żoch
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyse the contribution of rising longevity to the increase in wealth inequality in the U.S. over the past seventy years. To do so, we construct an overlapping generations (OLG) model with multiple sources of inequality, carefully calibrated to the data. Our key finding is that improvements in old-age longevity have a substantial impact on wealth inequality, accounting for approximately half the effect of income inequality, which has been the focus of much of the existing literature. In contrast, the impact of tax changes is relatively minor. The contribution of rising longevity is expected to continue driving wealth inequality upward in the coming decades.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了过去七十年间美国寿命延长对财富不平等加剧的贡献。为此，我们构建了一个包含多种不平等来源的代际重叠（OLG）模型，并仔细校准至数据。我们的核心发现是，老年寿命的改善对财富不平等有显著影响，其效应约为收入不平等影响的一半，而后者一直是现有文献关注的焦点。相比之下，税收变化的影响相对较小。预期寿命延长将在未来几十年内继续推动财富不平等上升。

title: DP20715 Identity and Institutional Change: Evidence from First Names in Germany, 1700–1850
title_zh: 身份与制度变迁：来自德国1700—1850年名字的证据
title_primary: 身份与制度变迁：来自德国1700—1850年名字的证据
title_secondary: DP20715 Identity and Institutional Change: Evidence from First Names in Germany, 1700–1850
authors: Matthias Weigand, Cathrin Mohr, Davide Cantoni
official: 官方在线 2025-10-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How does culture respond to institutional change? We study the collapse of the Holy Roman Empire (1789–1815), when half of Central Europe changed rulers. Using 44 million birth records from hundreds of cities between 1700 and 1850, we measure cultural traits in real time. Cities that experienced ruler change saw greater naming turnover, dispersion, and novelty. We construct control groups using diplomatic records to isolate these effects, which emerged immediately and persisted. The collapse of hegemonic authority weakened state-aligned identities while strengthening religiosity and nationalism. These shifts undermined subsequent state building, highlighting challenges of ideological integration after regime change.
abstract_zh: 文化如何应对制度变迁？我们以神圣罗马帝国的解体（1789-1815年）为研究对象，彼时中欧半数地区更换了统治者。利用1700年至1850年间数百座城市的4400万条出生记录，我们实时衡量了文化特征。经历统治者更迭的城市，其命名更替率、多样性和新颖性均有所提升。我们借助外交档案构建对照组以隔离这些效应，发现其影响即时显现且持续存在。霸权权威的崩溃削弱了与国家一致的认同，同时强化了宗教情感与民族主义。这些转变进而阻碍了后续的国家建设，凸显了政权更迭后意识形态整合所面临的挑战。

title: Environmental implications of Brazil’s tax reform on household consumption
title_zh: 巴西税制改革对家庭消费的环境影响
title_primary: 巴西税制改革对家庭消费的环境影响
title_secondary: Environmental implications of Brazil’s tax reform on household consumption
authors: Samuel Bícego, Paula Carvalho Pereda
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Brazil’s recent tax reform replaces several indirect taxes with a unified Value-Added Tax (VAT), introduces additional rates on goods harmful to health or the environment, exempts several food products, and provides cashback transfers to low-income households. We evaluate the environmental and distributional effects of this reform by combining detailed household expenditure data with product- and state-level carbon footprint estimates that incorporate all emissions sources, including land-use change. The reform, as designed, is projected to increase consumption-based greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 1.7% (or 49 kilograms per capita), primarily because high-emission food products become tax-exempt. At the same time, lower-income households experience welfare gains through lower food prices and cashback transfers, revealing a trade-off between distributional and environmental objectives. We then evaluate counterfactual scenarios in which additional tax rates are extended to carbon-intensive goods and revenues are recycled through targeted transfers and subsidies. These scenarios reverse the increase in emissions and achieve reductions with relatively limited welfare losses, particularly when revenues subsidize lower-emission food consumption. Our findings show that targeted environmental taxation combined with compensatory transfers can better align tax policy with climate goals without sacrificing distributional objectives.
abstract_zh: 巴西近期的税制改革以统一增值税（VAT）取代多项间接税，对危害健康或环境的商品征收附加税率，豁免多种食品，并向低收入家庭提供现金返还转移。我们通过将详细家庭支出数据与涵盖所有排放源（包括土地利用变化）的产品及州级碳足迹估算相结合，评估了该改革的环境与分配效应。按设计，该改革预计将使基于消费的温室气体（GHG）排放增加1.7%（即人均49千克），主要原因是高排放食品获得免税。与此同时，低收入家庭通过食品价格下降和现金返还转移获得福利改善，这揭示了分配目标与环境目标之间的权衡。随后，我们评估了反事实情景，其中将附加税率扩展至碳密集型商品，并将收入通过定向转移和补贴进行循环利用。这些情景逆转了排放增长，并在福利损失相对有限的情况下实现减排，尤其是当收入用于补贴低碳食品消费时。我们的研究结果表明，针对性的环境税收与补偿性转移相结合，能够在不牺牲分配目标的前提下，更好地使税收政策与气候目标保持一致。

title: After the fire: How Ukrainian strikes disrupt local economies around Russian refineries
title_zh: 火灾之后：乌克兰袭击如何扰乱俄罗斯炼油厂周边的地方经济
title_primary: 火灾之后：乌克兰袭击如何扰乱俄罗斯炼油厂周边的地方经济

authors: Štěpán Mikula, Fabio Sabatini
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Measuring the local economic effects of Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian oil refineries is difficult because reliable local data are scarce and both information and statistics are tightly controlled. This column uses nighttime lights as a proxy for economic activity to show that strikes on fixed industrial assets can generate economically meaningful and persistent local losses. They also illustrate how these losses can be measured when conventional data are unavailable, delayed, or difficult to verify independently.
abstract_zh: 衡量乌克兰远程打击俄罗斯炼油厂对当地经济的影响十分困难，因为可靠的当地数据稀缺，且信息与统计均受到严格管控。本专栏以夜间灯光作为经济活动的代理指标，表明对固定工业资产的打击能够造成具有经济意义且持续性的当地损失。同时，这些发现也展示了在传统数据不可获取、存在滞后或难以独立验证的情况下，如何衡量此类损失。

title: Party Organizations and Complementary Political Control,
title_zh: 党组织与互补性政治控制
title_primary: 党组织与互补性政治控制
title_secondary: Party Organizations and Complementary Political Control,
authors: Ajay Shenoy, Laura V Zimmermann
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how political parties engage in political targeting of resources by coordinating politicians across multiple levels of government. We combine thousands of election outcomes from the Indian state of West Bengal with 300 million payments from a welfare scheme jointly controlled by state and local governments. We show that the state government gives disproportionate funding to co-partisan local councils, which target payments to raise votes for national candidates. Welfare payments are diverted to reward local councilors who successfully deliver votes, and to recruit opposition councilors. The ruling party recruits candidates only where it lacks a majority, systematically expanding its control.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了政党如何通过协调多级政府中的政治家来实施政治资源定向。我们将印度西孟加拉邦数千个选举结果与一项由邦政府和地方政府共同控制的福利计划中3亿笔支付记录相结合。研究显示，邦政府向同党地方议会提供不成比例的资金，这些资金被用于定向支付以提升国家层面候选人的得票率。福利支付被挪用，用于奖励成功拉票的地方议员，并招募反对党议员。执政党仅在未获得多数席位的地方招募候选人，从而系统性地扩大其控制范围。

title_zh: 部分线性模型的单步估计

authors: Daniel J. Henderson, Nadine McCloud, Christopher F. Parmeter
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider a single-step approach to estimating the parametric coefficients and bandwidth parameters in a partially linear model. We establish a direct connection between this estimator and the two-step estimator of Robinson (1988). Simulations show that the resulting estimator improves recovery of the nonparametric component and the fitted conditional mean in most designs, while delivering coefficient estimates that are typically comparable to Robinson’s two-step estimator.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一种单步方法，用于估计部分线性模型中的参数系数和带宽参数。我们建立了该估计器与Robinson（1988）两步估计器之间的直接联系。模拟结果表明，在大多数设计下，由此产生的估计器改善了非参数成分的恢复及拟合条件均值，同时提供的系数估计通常与Robinson的两步估计器相当。

title: Supply Chain Tectonics: Empirics on How the EU Is Plotting Its Path Through Global Trade Fragmentation
title_zh: 供应链构造学：欧盟如何在全球贸易碎片化中规划路径的实证研究
title_primary: 供应链构造学：欧盟如何在全球贸易碎片化中规划路径的实证研究
title_secondary: Supply Chain Tectonics: Empirics on How the EU Is Plotting Its Path Through Global Trade Fragmentation
authors: Román Arjona, William Connell, Cristina Herghelegiu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines indications of shifts in the European Union's (EU) import relationships in an increasingly fragmented global trade environment. Using highly disaggregated product‐level trade data, we provide an initial exploration of the reallocation of EU import flows over the 2021–2024 period, considering what these emerging patterns may imply for diversification and price developments. The timing of this analysis is relevant given rising geopolitical uncertainties and the parallel rollout of EU initiatives aimed at enhancing internal capacities and mitigating risks in critical supply chains. Our findings indicate that the EU's supply chains show initial signs of adaptability within the evolving global landscape. Despite sectoral differences, our analysis points to a recent overall shift in EU imports away from countries lacking bilateral trade initiatives with the EU towards the EU itself, as well as neighbouring and distant partners engaged in such initiatives. We find indications that this development is associated with higher overall diversification in EU imports across all partners. However, the reallocation seems more focused on a subset of agreement partners, which may partly reflect the gradual adjustment needed to build capacity elsewhere. In addition, we find mixed evidence of short‐term upward pressure on prices. All in all, the paper aims to highlight emerging trends in EU imports and the related challenges of balancing efficiency and resilience.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在全球贸易环境日益碎片化的背景下，欧盟进口关系发生变化的迹象。利用高度细化的产品层面贸易数据，我们初步探索了2021-2024年期间欧盟进口流的重新配置，并探讨这些新兴模式对多元化和价格发展的潜在影响。鉴于地缘政治不确定性上升，以及欧盟同步推出旨在增强内部能力并降低关键供应链风险的举措，本研究的时机具有现实意义。我们的研究结果表明，欧盟供应链在全球格局演变中展现出初步的适应能力。尽管存在行业差异，但分析指出，近期欧盟进口整体上正从缺乏双边贸易协定的国家转向欧盟自身，以及参与此类协定的邻近和远距离伙伴。我们发现，这一趋势与欧盟进口在所有伙伴中的整体多元化程度提高相关。然而，重新配置似乎更集中于部分协定伙伴，这在一定程度上可能反映了在其他地区建设产能所需的渐进调整过程。此外，关于短期价格上行压力，我们发现了不一致的证据。总体而言，本文旨在揭示欧盟进口的新兴趋势，以及平衡效率与韧性所面临的相关挑战。

title: Considering trade policy: Then and now

abstract: In this essay, I begin with the pioneering contribution of James Brander's doctoral dissertation to our understanding of international trade under oligopolistic competition. I then mention some of our early joint work showing that oligopoly creates a profit-shifting role for import tariffs and export subsidies. Our work also includes the role of subsidies to R&D/investment for international profit shifting in an oligopoly setting in which firms make sequential decisions with respect to R&D and exports. Trade policy incorporating considerations of rent- or profit-shifting is often referred to as “strategic trade policy.” After a very brief consideration of some criticisms concerning the generality of strategic trade policy results, I turn to a few thoughts on the recent move toward a much more protectionist US trade policy. I argue that a consideration of profit-shifting effects and subsequent investment and location decisions by large oligopolistic firms inside or outside the United States is essential for an understanding of the overall gains and losses from US trade policy.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我首先回顾了詹姆斯·布兰德博士论文对寡头竞争下国际贸易理解的先驱性贡献。随后，我提及了我们早期的一些合作研究，这些研究表明寡头垄断为进口关税和出口补贴创造了利润转移的作用。我们的工作还涵盖了在寡头垄断环境中，企业就研发与出口做出序贯决策时，研发/投资补贴在国际利润转移中的作用。将租金或利润转移考量纳入其中的贸易政策常被称为“战略性贸易政策”。在简要探讨了关于战略性贸易政策结果普遍性的一些批评之后，我转而思考近期美国贸易政策向更加保护主义方向转变的几点看法。我认为，考虑利润转移效应以及美国境内外大型寡头企业随后的投资和选址决策，对于理解美国贸易政策的整体得失至关重要。

title: Shockflation in the EU: sectoral shocks, cost-push inflation and structural asymmetries in core and periphery countries
title_zh: 欧盟的冲击性通胀：核心与外围国家的部门冲击、成本推动型通胀与结构性不对称
title_primary: 欧盟的冲击性通胀：核心与外围国家的部门冲击、成本推动型通胀与结构性不对称
title_secondary: Shockflation in the EU: sectoral shocks, cost-push inflation and structural asymmetries in core and periphery countries
authors: Ferreira, Vicente, Ferreira, João Pedro, Guarascio, Dario, Zezza, Francesco
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The return of inflation in Western economies has fueled the debate on its main drivers, bringing sector-specific shocks and supply chain bottlenecks to the forefront. Building on the seminal approach of Weber et al. (2024), this paper develops a method to assess the degree of exposure to these shocks in EU countries. Using inter-country input-output data stemming from the FIGARO database, we identify systemically significant sectors in four regions within the EU: Core, Southern Periphery, Eastern Periphery, and financial hubs. We also analyze exposure to foreign shocks. Two main conclusions can be drawn: on the one hand, periphery countries are more exposed to shocks originating in the EU core than the other way around; on the other hand, all EU regions are considerably exposed to price shocks originating from non-EU countries, namely Russia and China. The strategic dependencies of the block pose challenges for price stability and require targeted policies.
abstract_zh: 西方经济体通胀的回归加剧了对其主要驱动因素的争论，将行业特定冲击和供应链瓶颈推至前沿。本文基于Weber等人（2024）的开创性方法，开发了一种评估欧盟国家受这些冲击影响程度的方法。利用来自FIGARO数据库的国家间投入产出数据，我们识别了欧盟四个区域（核心区、南欧外围、东欧外围和金融中心）中具有系统重要性的行业。我们还分析了对外部冲击的暴露程度。主要得出两个结论：一方面，外围国家比核心国家更易受到源自欧盟核心区的冲击；另一方面，所有欧盟区域都显著暴露于源自非欧盟国家（即俄罗斯和中国）的价格冲击。欧盟的战略依赖性对价格稳定构成挑战，需要采取有针对性的政策。

authors: Nathaniel Baum‐Snow, Aled ab Iorwerth, James Macek
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Since 2000, housing markets across Canada have experienced growth rates in prices that far exceed corresponding rates of household income growth. However, rents have grown at similar rates to household incomes. In the 2015–24 period, immigration has been a central booster of housing demand and population growth, compensating for declining birth rates. Annual per capita housing unit new construction rates have grown slightly, to about 0.0075 across all types of markets for 1991–2024, even as Canada's population boomed in 2023–24, with the composition shifting markedly from single‐family homes to multifamily structures. Purpose‐built rental construction has recently risen from very low levels. To understand these patterns, we consider local regulatory environments and infrastructure provision, rental housing supports, sources of housing demand growth, and Canada's macroprudential regulatory institutions and environment.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自2000年以来，加拿大各地住房市场的价格增长率远超家庭收入增长率。然而，租金增长与家庭收入增长速率相近。在2015年至2024年期间，移民成为住房需求和人口增长的主要推动力，弥补了出生率下降的影响。尽管加拿大在2023年至2024年间人口激增，但1991年至2024年间，各类市场的年人均新建住房单元率略有上升，约为0.0075，且住房结构从独户住宅显著转向多户住宅。专为出租而建的住房建设近期从极低水平开始回升。为理解这些现象，我们考察了地方监管环境与基础设施供给、租赁住房支持、住房需求增长来源，以及加拿大的宏观审慎监管制度与环境。

title: Land tenure conflicts in Ghana and Zimbabwe: An institutional perspective
title_zh: 加纳与津巴布韦的土地权属冲突：制度视角
title_primary: 加纳与津巴布韦的土地权属冲突：制度视角
title_secondary: Land tenure conflicts in Ghana and Zimbabwe: An institutional perspective
authors: Abel Gwaindepi, Helen Akolgo-Azupogo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land frontiers in Africa are closing rapidly, with significant implications for family, clan, and chieftaincy conflicts. This study examines the evolution of land tenure systems and related conflicts in Ghana and Zimbabwe using a neocustomary and statist archetypal exploratory framework, drawing on national survey data, the Social Conflict Analysis Database (SCAD), and qualitative interviews in conflict hotspot regions of both countries. While both nations inherited British colonial land management systems with some similarities, their postcolonial trajectories diverged: Zimbabwe adopted a statist approach, while Ghana pursued a decentralised neocustomary model, shaping their flagship reforms—the Fast-Track Land Redistribution (FTRP) and the Land Administration Project (LAP) respectively. The results indicate that neither regime type inherently possesses effective conflict management mechanisms, as both fail to safeguard the rights of the marginalised. While conflicts in Ghana tend to be localised and protracted, often with high mortality, Zimbabwe’s statist mechanisms can suppress disputes quickly, though often without guarantees of fairness. For policy and research, the study underscores that neither statist nor neocustomary regimes deliver egalitarian outcomes in conflict resolution by design; both require robust accountability mechanisms and safeguards to protect vulnerable groups. Decentralisation may allow deliberative and inclusive outcomes, but evidence of the numerous conflicts, lengthy dispute resolution processes, and high conflict mortality shows this is not guaranteed. Similarly, centralised systems may be expeditious but risk politicisation, top-down bureaucratic inefficiencies, and inequitable outcomes. Ultimately, the effectiveness of conflict resolution depends less on regime type and more on the legitimacy and capacity of embedded institutional safeguards.
abstract_zh: 非洲的土地边界正在迅速闭合，这对家庭、氏族和酋长领地冲突产生了重大影响。本研究采用新习俗主义与国家主义原型探索性框架，利用两国全国调查数据、社会冲突分析数据库（SCAD）以及对加纳和津巴布韦冲突热点地区的定性访谈，考察了两国土地权属制度及其相关冲突的演变。尽管两国都继承了英国殖民时期的土地管理制度，存在一定相似性，但其后殖民路径却分道扬镳：津巴布韦采取了国家主义路径，而加纳则推行了去中心化的新习俗主义模式，分别塑造了其标志性改革——快速通道土地重新分配计划（FTRP）和土地管理项目（LAP）。结果表明，两种制度类型均非天然具备有效的冲突管理机制，因为两者都未能保障边缘化群体的权利。加纳的冲突往往局部化且旷日持久，常伴随高死亡率，而津巴布韦的国家主义机制虽能迅速压制争端，却往往无法保证公平。就政策与研究而言，本研究强调，国家主义与新习俗主义制度均非设计上就能在冲突解决中实现平等结果；两者都需要强有力的问责机制和保障措施来保护弱势群体。去中心化或许能促成协商性和包容性的结果，但众多冲突、冗长的争端解决过程以及高冲突死亡率的证据表明，这并非必然。同样，中央集权体系可能高效迅速，但存在政治化、自上而下的官僚低效以及结果不公的风险。归根结底，冲突解决的有效性更多取决于嵌入制度性保障措施的合法性与能力，而非制度类型本身。

title: Extreme weather and economic crisis in the 1430s in England, and the implications for tenurial change
title_zh: 1430年代英格兰极端天气与经济危机及其对土地保有制度变革的影响
title_primary: 1430年代英格兰极端天气与经济危机及其对土地保有制度变革的影响
title_secondary: Extreme weather and economic crisis in the 1430s in England, and the implications for tenurial change
authors: Mark Bailey
official: 官方在线 2026-03-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The 1430s were characterized by extreme weather conditions, food and fodder shortages, and high mortalities among animals and humans, although the severity of events and their consequences in England have received limited attention. The economic downturn and the depressed customary land market in this decade marked the beginning of the Great Slump, which lasted until at least the 1460s. Evidence is drawn from across England to sketch the anatomy of the crisis, followed by consideration of its impact on tenurial change. Various devices adopted in the 1430s to retain or attract tenants gained traction over the next three decades. Some lords opted to alienate sections of their demesnes permanently into the peasant sector on customary tenure; the practice of leasing customary land diminished; grants of land for money tenure held heritably or for lives now became the dominant form of customary tenure; and the issue of copies of unfree land transfers became widespread. These changes were decisive in preventing any return to direct demesne management and the traditional servile tenures based on labour services and uncertain dues, and created the essential preconditions for the emergence of copyhold tenure.
abstract_zh: 1430年代以极端天气条件、食物和饲料短缺以及动物和人类高死亡率为特征，尽管这些事件及其后果在英格兰的严重性受到的关注有限。这十年的经济衰退和习惯土地市场的低迷标志着大萧条的起始，该萧条持续至至少1460年代。证据来自英格兰各地，用以勾勒危机的轮廓，随后考虑其对保有形式变化的影响。1430年代为保留或吸引佃户而采取的各种措施在接下来的三十年间逐渐获得势头。一些领主选择将其直营地部分永久转让给农民部门，以习惯保有形式持有；习惯土地的租赁做法减少；以金钱保有形式授予土地，可继承或终身持有的赠予，如今成为习惯保有土地的主要形式；非自由土地转让副本的发放变得普遍。这些变化在防止回归直接直营地管理和基于劳役及不确定费用的传统农奴保有方面起到了决定性作用，并为公簿保有权的出现创造了必要的先决条件。

title: Conditional persistence? Historical disease exposure and government response to COVID-19
title_zh: 条件性持续？历史疾病暴露与政府对COVID-19的应对
title_primary: 条件性持续？历史疾病暴露与政府对COVID-19的应对
title_secondary: Conditional persistence? Historical disease exposure and government response to COVID-19
authors: Annika Lindskog, Ola Olsson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Drawing on the literature on cultural adaptations to historical disease exposure, we investigate differences in government containment policies during the COVID-19 pandemic. We hypothesize that a higher historical exposure to disease resulted in a stronger government response to recent COVID deaths, particularly during the first year of the pandemic characterized by fundamental uncertainty. Our empirical analysis confirms this hypothesis, both for differences in government responses to disease dynamics between countries and for differences in state-level containment policies within the United States. Our results suggest that the impact of historical health legacies on contemporary policy may be conditional on the character of the public health risk at hand. Deep cultural norms, determined by historical experiences, may play a minor role most of the time but are activated in times of fundamental uncertainty. • High historic pathogen prevalence (HPP) may trigger strong intuitive disease response. • Countries with high HPP had stronger COVID-19 policy responses in 2020. • The same pattern appeared across U.S. states. • Early on, people in high HPP-countries were more anxious and supportive of curfews. • Historical behavioral norms seem to matter more in times of fundamental uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 借鉴关于文化适应历史疾病暴露的文献，我们研究了COVID-19大流行期间政府防控政策的差异。我们假设，历史上较高的疾病暴露程度会导致政府对近期新冠死亡病例采取更强烈的应对措施，尤其是在以根本不确定性为特征的大流行第一年。我们的实证分析证实了这一假设，既体现在各国政府对疾病动态反应的差异上，也体现在美国各州层面防控政策的差异上。我们的结果表明，历史健康遗产对当代政策的影响可能取决于当前公共卫生风险的性质。由历史经历决定的深层文化规范，在大多数时候可能作用有限，但在根本不确定性时期会被激活。• 高历史病原体流行率（HPP）可能触发强烈的直觉性疾病应对反应。• 高HPP国家在2020年采取了更强有力的COVID-19政策应对措施。• 这一模式同样出现在美国各州之间。• 早期，高HPP国家的民众更为焦虑，并更支持宵禁措施。• 历史行为规范似乎在根本不确定性时期更为重要。

title: Economic policy uncertainty and institutional investor cliques
title_zh: 经济政策不确定性与机构投资者派系
title_primary: 经济政策不确定性与机构投资者派系
title_secondary: Economic policy uncertainty and institutional investor cliques
authors: Chaohua He Jin Zhi Wen Zhang Yuxuan Geng School of International Trade and Economics, University of International Business and Economics, Beijing, P.R.China
official: 官方在线 2025-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The paper examines how economic policy uncertainty (EPU) would impact the clique behaviour of institutional investors. By probing the link between EPU and the shareholdings of institutional investors, we find that EPU prompts institutional investors to clique, especially in enterprises with sound social performance, experienced executives, high analyst coverage, state property, and large scale. EPU may facilitate institutional investor cliques through channels of exacerbating agency problems, enterprise cash flows, enterprise risk and enterprise-investor information asymmetry. Namely, EPU motivates institutional investors to clique to tackle EPU-induced challenges. Evidence further demonstrates that institutional investor cliques aggravate the negative impact of EPU on macroeconomy but mitigate that on business performance. The findings suggest that EPU fuels institutional investor cliques and both impede macroeconomy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济政策不确定性（EPU）如何影响机构投资者的“抱团”行为。通过探究EPU与机构投资者持股之间的联系，我们发现EPU促使机构投资者形成抱团，尤其是在社会绩效良好、高管经验丰富、分析师覆盖度高、国有性质及规模较大的企业中尤为显著。EPU可能通过加剧代理问题、企业现金流问题、企业风险以及企业与投资者之间的信息不对称等渠道，促进机构投资者的抱团行为。换言之，EPU激励机构投资者抱团以应对由EPU引发的挑战。进一步证据表明，机构投资者抱团加剧了EPU对宏观经济的负面影响，但缓解了其对经营业绩的不利影响。研究结果表明，EPU助长了机构投资者的抱团现象，且两者均对宏观经济构成阻碍。
